meta.name: update-skills
meta.description: Re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream.

copy.tagline: 重新应用已安装的技能以拉取最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已安装多个技能并希望保持它们最新
copy.tagline_en: Re-apply installed skills to pull their latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have installed skills and want to keep them up-to-date

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以运行 /update-skills 命令，检查并列出已安装的技能（如 Slack、Discord 等），让你选择要更新的，然后自动重新应用每个技能的最新代码，并验证构建和测试。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中输入 /update-skills 时触发。若工作目录有未提交改动，会提示先清理。

say.text: 更新所有已安装的技能
say.note: 列出可更新的技能供选择。

say.text: 显示当前已安装的技能列表
say.note: 列出技能但不执行更新。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run the /update-skills command, which checks the working tree, detects installed skills (e.g., Slack, Discord), lets you pick which to update, then re-applies each selected skill's latest code from upstream, and validates with build and test.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /update-skills in Claude Code. If the working tree is dirty, it asks you to commit or stash first.

say_en.note: Shows the list for you to choose.

say_en.text: Show the list of installed skills
